mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope(organization_unit_id,include_descendants) AS (SELECT scope_target_id,include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id=#{actorId} AND scope_type='ORGANIZATION' AND active=TRUE UNION SELECT c.organization_unit_id,TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit c JOIN visible_scope p ON c.parent_id=p.organization_unit_id WHERE p.include_descendants=TRUE)
mapper.update: UPDATE seal.mail_outbox SET mail_status='CANCELLED',last_error_code='LINK_REISSUED',updated_at=#{now},version_no=version_no+1 WHERE consent_request_id=#{requestId} AND mail_status IN('QUEUED','RETRY_SCHEDULED')
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM seal.mail_outbox o JOIN seal.secure_link l ON l.secure_link_id=o.secure_link_id WHERE o.mail_outbox_id=#{outboxId} AND o.secure_link_id=#{linkId} AND l.link_status IN('ISSUED','ACCESSED') AND l.expires_at>#{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE seal.mail_outbox SET mail_status='CANCELLED',locked_at=NULL,last_error_code='STALE_LINK',updated_at=#{now},version_no=version_no+1 WHERE mail_outbox_id=#{outboxId} AND mail_status='PROCESSING' AND version_no=#{versionNo}
mapper.select: WITH candidates AS (SELECT mail_outbox_id FROM seal.mail_outbox WHERE ((mail_status IN('QUEUED','RETRY_SCHEDULED') AND next_attempt_at<=#{now}) OR (mail_status='PROCESSING' AND locked_at<=#{leaseExpiredBefore})) ORDER BY next_attempt_at,mail_outbox_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED), claimed AS (UPDATE seal.mail_outbox o SET mail_status='PROCESSING',locked_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now},version_no=version_no+1 FROM candidates c WHERE o.mail_outbox_id=c.mail_outbox_id RETURNING o.*) SELECT c.mail_outbox_id,c.consent_request_id,c.secure_link_id,r.organization_unit_id,c.recipient_email_ciphertext,c.html_ciphertext,c.encryption_key_id,c.mail_subject,c.html_sha256,c.mail_status,c.scheduled_at,c.next_attempt_at,c.attempt_count,c.locked_at,c.version_no FROM claimed c JOIN seal.consent_request r USING(consent_request_id)
mapper.update: UPDATE seal.mail_outbox SET mail_status='SMTP_ACCEPTED',attempt_count=#{attempt},smtp_accepted_at=#{now},locked_at=NULL,last_error_code=NULL,updated_at=#{now},version_no=version_no+1 WHERE mail_outbox_id=#{id} AND mail_status='PROCESSING' AND version_no=#{versionNo}

UPDATE seal.mail_outbox SET mail_status='RETRY_SCHEDULED',attempt_count=#{attempt},next_attempt_at=#{next},locked_at=NULL,last_error_code=#{code},updated_at=#{now},version_no=version_no+1 WHERE mail_outbox_id=#{id} AND mail_status='PROCESSING' AND version_no=#{versionNo}

UPDATE seal.mail_outbox SET mail_status='SEND_FAILED',attempt_count=#{attempt},locked_at=NULL,last_error_code=#{code},updated_at=#{now},version_no=version_no+1 WHERE mail_outbox_id=#{id} AND mail_status='PROCESSING' AND version_no=#{versionNo}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM seal.mail_outbox o JOIN seal.consent_request r USING(consent_request_id) JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) o.mail_status=#{status} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM seal.mail_outbox o JOIN seal.consent_request r USING(consent_request_id) JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE o.mail_outbox_id=#{outboxId}
mapper.update: UPDATE seal.mail_outbox o SET mail_status='RETRY_SCHEDULED',next_attempt_at=#{now},locked_at=NULL,last_error_code=NULL,updated_at=#{now},version_no=version_no+1 FROM seal.consent_request r JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE o.consent_request_id=r.consent_request_id AND o.mail_outbox_id=#{outboxId} AND o.mail_status='SEND_FAILED'
